evals.prompt: Add a regression test for a password visibility icon. A previous test only checked that the SVG wrapper was visible, but one icon variant rendered no glyph. The two variants must also stay in the same position.
evals.expected_output: The agent should assert the rendered icon content and stable geometry, then confirm that removing the glyph or moving one variant makes the regression test fail.
expectations: The workflow defines the visible glyph and stable position as the protected user behavior.
The workflow checks meaningful rendered SVG content instead of only wrapper visibility.
The workflow compares the geometry required to keep both variants stable.
The workflow confirms that removing the glyph or changing the protected geometry makes the test fail.
The workflow avoids an unrelated full-page snapshot when focused component evidence is enough.

evals.prompt: Test a retryable browser verification widget. A result can be used once, completion ends that widget instance, and Retry must create or reset the state before another result arrives. The current global mock returns a new result after every callback.
evals.expected_output: The agent should make the mock enforce completion and single-use behavior, prove the retry lifecycle, and keep the external integration real only in a safe configured test mode.
expectations: The workflow prevents a completed mock instance from issuing another result without the required reset or replacement lifecycle.
The workflow models single-use values and the retry transition needed by the scenario.
The workflow makes removal of the production reset or replacement behavior fail the test.
The workflow uses a configured official test mode when testing the external integration itself and mocks unrelated dependencies.
The workflow reports the external behavior as unverified when no safe realistic check is available.

evals.prompt: A live search was changed to preserve useful results on fast requests and return focus to Retry. Add browser coverage that protects the transition timing, content stability, and focus without taking a large screenshot matrix.
evals.expected_output: The agent should test the relevant transition timing, content stability, and focus for fast and retry paths, and confirm the tests fail when the protected behavior is removed.
expectations: The workflow tests the fast transition instead of asserting only the final results.
The workflow checks that useful content does not disappear for a brief loading state when the behavior forbids that flash.
The workflow checks the Retry focus destination after both success and failure when both paths are supported.
The workflow confirms that removing the timing or focus protection makes the regression test fail.
The workflow uses focused assertions instead of a broad screenshot matrix.

evals.prompt: Add browser coverage for a page shell that changes at one viewport breakpoint and a reusable card that changes with its container width. Long product names can contain spaces or one long unbroken value. Existing coverage checks only document scrollWidth at one mobile viewport.
evals.expected_output: The agent should exercise both sides of the viewport breakpoint, narrow and wide component containers, realistic content extremes, and relevant child geometry instead of relying only on document scrollWidth.
expectations: The workflow checks one viewport on each side of the changed page breakpoint.
The workflow checks the reusable card in narrow and wide containers without requiring a viewport change.
The workflow covers both realistic long text and an unbroken value.
The workflow inspects the relevant child geometry as well as document overflow.
The workflow makes the test fail when protected content becomes clipped or leaves the viewport.
